name: Black Lilies - Eternal Summer
source:
"I wish this summer vacation would never end..." Everybody has probably thought that at some point. But what if such a thing were to really come true?

Alice Hanekawa and her 6 friends have been trapped, repeating their summer vacation for over 10 years. At first, it was fun... But fun gave way to boredom, boredom gave way to frustration, and it's only a matter of time before frustration gives way to madness. All of them are tired and worn down, and they barely talk to one another anymore... Everyone has splintered into little groups, and the unity they once had has completely eroded away. Even death is no escape.

Nothing has changed... But something has to. Of course, they've tried to find a way out before; tried to figure out the truth behind the time loop. It's hardly her first attempt, but Alice has to do something... She's more desperate now than ever before. But will that really be enough? Even if she finds a way out, can she heal everybody's hearts before they leave? And what deeper mysteries could these time loops truly be holding?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1472010/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“真希望这个暑假永远不要结束……”大概每个人都曾这样想过。可如果真的实现了呢？

Alice Hanekawa与六位朋友，被困在重复的暑假中，已经超过十年。起初，一切很有趣……但乐趣变成无聊，无聊变成挫败，而挫败走向疯狂，也只是时间问题。所有人都疲惫不堪，几乎不再交谈……大家分裂成小团体，曾经的团结早已消磨殆尽。就连死亡，也无法带来解脱。

一切都没有改变……可总得有什么改变。当然，他们以前也尝试过寻找出路，查明时间循环背后的真相。这远非Alice第一次尝试，但她必须做点什么……如今，她比任何时候都更绝望。可这真的足够吗？即便找到出口，她能在离开前，治愈每个人的心吗？这些时间循环，又究竟藏着怎样更深的谜团？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1472010/]Steam[/url]]
